title: 2024 Bowman Base Chrome Prospect #BCP-20 Antonio Anderson - Boston Red Sox
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Base Chrome Prospect #BCP-20 trading card features Antonio Anderson of the Boston Red Sox. The card is a sports trading card manufactured by Topps and is part of the 2024 Bowman set. It is a Chrome parallel/variety card that is not in original packaging or professionally graded. 

The card is perfect for collectors of baseball memorabilia and fans of the Boston Red Sox. It is a great addition to any collection of sports trading cards and is sure to impress. The card is not autoed and is categorized under Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Trading Card Singles.
